ideas.name: news: first 5 minutes continue
ideas.why: a macro surprise is absorbed over minutes, not seconds; the first move's direction keeps going as slower money reacts

ideas.name: MACD divergence at a 30-min extreme
ideas.why: a new high on weaker momentum than the last high means fewer buyers are pushing it; the classic exhaustion sign

ideas.name: small overnight range breakout
ideas.why: a quiet night leaves orders unfilled; a break of a narrow overnight range starts a range-expansion day

ideas.name: range exhausted, fade the extreme
ideas.why: once a session has used its usual range, new extremes are made by the last late chasers

ideas.name: prior day's direction, the morning fade
ideas.why: the regime-bias study's best lead: a trending day is often unwound the next morning

ideas.name: half-hour turn
ideas.why: orders worked in half-hour slices (TWAPs, rebalances) pause at :00 and :30, so the half hour's move fades

ideas.name: flip1 when VXN is above its 60-day median
ideas.why: fearful markets trend in bursts; calm ones chop

ideas.name: flip1 after a narrow overnight
ideas.why: a narrow night sets up a trend day, where flips follow through

ideas.name: flip1 with the day's range mostly unused
ideas.why: with most of the usual range left there is room to run

ideas.name: flip1 within 30 min of a release
ideas.why: flips right after news ride the new information

ideas.name: flip1 against the prior day
ideas.why: the next-session reversal lean: flips that undo yesterday carry

ideas.name: flip1 on options-expiry Fridays
ideas.why: dealer hedging pins price near strikes on expiry, so flips fail

ideas.name: flip1 breaking the day's range
ideas.why: a flip at a new session high/low is a breakout; mid-range flips are noise

ideas.name: potM1 with the range used up
ideas.why: easing momentum once the usual range is spent marks the day's turn

ideas.name: potM1 with VXN below its median
ideas.why: in calm markets moves mean-revert, so easing warnings follow through

ideas.name: potE1 near VWAP
ideas.why: the screen found warnings toward VWAP help; near VWAP there is no pull, so they should not
